chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Part of a man's dignity is that he makes his provisions pleasant when he sets out on a journey."

key_terms.يُطَيِّبَ: to make good, pleasant, or wholesome
key_terms.ٱلرَّجُلِ: the man; here meaning a person's honorable conduct

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about proper etiquette and dignity in travel?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a refinement of conduct in travel: a person's dignity is shown by preparing good and pleasant provisions for the journey. It reflects prophetic guidance on etiquette, self-respect, and maintaining proper standards even while traveling.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2454 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said:
"Part of a man's dignity is that he makes his provisions pleasant when he sets out on a journey."
